TSVV: Raag Dhanasari, in Ghar 1, the four-stanza bani of Guru Nanak Dev ji.
Dhanaasaree, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:
AH1X: Akal Purakh is One, whose name is 'the One who exists', who is the creator of the creation, who pervades all, who is free of fear, who is free of enmity, whose form is beyond time (that is, whose body is free of destruction), who does not come into the cycle of births, whose light has come from himself, and who is found by the grace of the Satguru.
One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
There is but One God. True is His Name and creative His personality. He is without, fear, without enmity, immortal in form, beyond birth and self-illumined. By Guru's grace is He obtained.
1EG2: Jeeo = the soul. Kai sio = before whom? Karee = may I make.
(The world is an ocean of sorrows; seeing these sorrows) my soul trembles (apart from the Lord no other saviour is to be seen) before whom should I make my entreaties.
My soul is afraid; to whom should I complain?
My soul is afraid, to whom should I complain?
Therefore my soul fears you alone; leaving you who are my own master, before whom else should I make my cry — that is, my cry is before you alone.
F7UL: Dookh visaran = the Lord who removes sorrow. Sevia = I have remembered. ||1||
(So, leaving other supports) I remember only the Lord who destroys sorrows; he is ever the one who bestows his bounties. ||1||
I serve Him, who makes me forget my pains; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||
I serve Him, who makes me forget my sorrow and is ever, ever and ever, the Giver.
O you who are the dispeller — that is, the remover — of sorrow, and the giver of gifts in all three ages! I have served you. ||1||
AS5E: Neet = daily. Nava = (that is, one who never wearies of giving his gifts). Datar = the giver of gifts. ||1|| Rahau ||

(And that) master of mine goes on bestowing his bounties for ever (but he never wearies of hearing my daily entreaties; in his bounties) he is every day as though he were bestowing for the very first time. ||1|| Rahau ||
My Lord and Master is forever new; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||
My Lord is always brand-new. Ever and ever he is the Giver. Pause.
O my Sahib! You are ever new, and you are the giver of gifts in all three ages. || Rahau ||
8B8K: Andin = every day, always. Ant = in the end.
O my soul! Every day that master ought to be remembered; in the end it is he alone who saves (from sorrows).
Night and day, I serve my Lord and Master; He shall save me in the end.
Night and day, I serve my Master and, in the end, He will deliver me.
Therefore, O Sahib who delivers at the last moment from the messengers of Yama and from sorrows! Let us serve you day and night and hear your (soe) glory, that is, your praise.
DYXZ: O soul! Listen attentively — (only by taking the support of that master) can one cross over (the ocean of sorrows). ||2||
Hearing and listening, O my dear sister, I have crossed over. ||2||
Hearing and hearing the Lord's Name O my fascinating lady, I have crossed the world ocean.
When my (kamani) wife, who is my intellect, becoming a hearer (sun), listens to your Name, then my crossing over the world-ocean will come about.
AW39: Daial = O home of mercy! Nam = through the Name. Tara = I can swim across, I can cross over.
O merciful Lord! (Show mercy, give me your Name, so that) through your Name I may cross over (this ocean of sorrows).
O Merciful Lord, Your Name carries me across.
O merciful Master's by Your Name shall I swim across.
O you of merciful form! By the repetition of your Name I shall swim across the world-ocean.
HGSW: I am ever a sacrifice to you. ||1|| Rahau ||
I am forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||
To You, I am ever a sacrifice. Pause.
For this alone I go a hundred times (sad) as a sacrifice upon you. ||1|| Rahau ||
R3UB: Sarban = everywhere. Sacha = the one who abides for ever.
The Lord who abides for ever is present everywhere; apart from him there is no other.
In all the world, there is only the One True Lord; there is no other at all.
In the whole world, there is but One True Lord and there is not any other.
O you of the form of truth! You alone are the form of all; apart from you there is no other.
DX0Z: Kau = to. Nadar = the glance of mercy. Karei = he does. ||3||
That being upon whom he casts his glance of mercy, he remembers him. ||3||
He alone serves the Lord, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||3||
He alone performs His service, on whom the Lord casts His gracious glance.
(Ta ki) your service is done by that one alone upon whom you yourself cast your glance of grace. ||3||
HKGD: Kev raha = how can I remain? I become distraught.
O beloved (Lord!) Without the remembrance of you I become distraught.
Without You, O Beloved, how could I even live?
O my Beloved, how can I live without You?
Therefore, O my beloved! How shall I remain without you — that is, I cannot remain without you.
PHS7: Give me some great gift, by virtue of which I may remain joined to your Name.
Bless me with such greatness, that I may remain attached to Your Name.
Bless me with such greatness, that I may remain attached to your Name.

Therefore give me that (vadiaee) desire by which, O Waheguru, I may remain ever attached to your Name — the meaning being that I may sing your praise alone. As it is said — ☬ "Having created, he watches over his own creation, as is his greatness."
SGF8: O beloved! Apart from you there is no other such, before whom I might go and make this entreaty. ||1|| Rahau ||
There is no other, O Beloved, to whom I can go and speak. ||1||Pause||
There is no other second, O my Love, to whom I may go to address myself. Pause.
O beloved! There is no other like you before whom I might go and utter it. ||1|| Rahau ||
3UB7: Sevee = I serve. Jachanu = I beg.
(To cross this ocean of sorrows) I remember only my master the Lord; I do not beg this boon from any other.
I serve my Lord and Master; I ask for no other.
I serve my Lord and beg not another.
Therefore, knowing you as my own Sahib, I serve you alone, and I do not beg any thing from any other.
88PR: Bind bind = moment by moment. Chukh chukh = piece by piece, a sacrifice. ||4||
Nanak is the servant of that (master) of his own; moment by moment he is a sacrifice to that master. ||4||
Nanak is His slave; moment by moment, bit by bit, he is a sacrifice to Him. ||4||
Nanak, is His slave and every moment is, every bit, a sacrifice to Him.

Sri Guru Nanak ji says: I am (ta ka) your servant, or the slave of those who repeat your Name. And for this I become, upon you and upon your servants, in a (bind) little while — that is, in a moment — (chukh chukh) piece by piece; the meaning being that I make an offering of mind and body and the rest. ||4||
YKHF: Vitahu = from. Sahib = O Sahib! ||1|| Rahau ||4||1||
O my master! I go moment by moment as a sacrifice to your Name. ||1|| Rahau ||4||1||
O Lord Master, I am a sacrifice to Your Name, moment by moment, bit by bit. ||1||Pause||4||1||
O Lord every moment, I am ever bit a sacrifice to Your Name. Pause.
O Sahib! Upon your Name too I become piece by piece in a moment and go as a sacrifice. ||1|| Rahau ||4||1|| ☬ Now he shows the impermanence of the body:
